cases.sentence: После этого я услышал голос, звучащий, как голос ___ людей.
cases.explain: «огромного множества» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: After these things I heard something like a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, “Hallelujah! Salvation, power, and glory belong to our God;

cases.sentence: Затем я услышал голос, звучавший, как голос множества людей или как шум ___, или как мощный раскат грома:
cases.explain: «могучих вод» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: I heard something like the voice of a great multitude, and like the voice of many waters, and like the voice of mighty thunders, saying, “Hallelujah! For the Lord our God, the Almighty, reigns!

cases.sentence: Затем я услышал голос, звучавший, как голос множества людей или как шум могучих вод, или как ___ грома:
cases.explain: «мощный раскат» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: I heard something like the voice of a great multitude, and like the voice of many waters, and like the voice of mighty thunders, saying, “Hallelujah! For the Lord our God, the Almighty, reigns!

cases.sentence: Я увидел раскрытые небеса и всадника на ___.
cases.explain: «белом коне» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: I saw the heaven opened, and behold, a white horse, and he who sat on it is called Faithful and True. In righteousness he judges and makes war.

cases.sentence: За Ним следует ___, всадники на белых конях, одетые в тончайшую льняную одежду, чистую и белую.
cases.explain: «небесное войско» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The armies which are in heaven followed him on white horses, clothed in white, pure, fine linen.

cases.sentence: За Ним следует небесное войско, всадники на ___, одетые в тончайшую льняную одежду, чистую и белую.
cases.explain: «белых конях» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: The armies which are in heaven followed him on white horses, clothed in white, pure, fine linen.

cases.sentence: Из Его рта выходит ___ , чтобы поражать им народы.
cases.explain: «острый меч» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Out of his mouth proceeds a sharp, double-edged sword, that with it he should strike the nations. He will rule them with an iron rod. He treads the wine press of the fierceness of the wrath of God, the Almighty.

cases.sentence: Он правит ___ и топчет в давильне виноград, готовя вино ярости и гнева Бога Вседержителя .
cases.explain: «железным скипетром» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Out of his mouth proceeds a sharp, double-edged sword, that with it he should strike the nations. He will rule them with an iron rod. He treads the wine press of the fierceness of the wrath of God, the Almighty.
